blocks.heading: Shoulder Pads

blocks.imageAlt: Moulded shoulder pads used for structuring blazers and jackets
blocks.heading: Structure That Sets Behind Every Clean Shoulder Line
blocks.html:
Shoulder pads are moulded inserts placed inside a jacket, blazer or coat to build and hold the shoulder shape the outer fabric alone cannot hold on its own. They sit at the point of the garment a buyer's eye goes to first — a jacket can be well cut everywhere else and still look wrong if the pad underneath is uneven or has gone flat.

Moulded consistency is the whole job here. A pair of pads that differ even slightly in curve, thickness or density will throw off the left-right symmetry of a finished garment, and that defect only shows up after the jacket is assembled — by which point the cost of the mistake has multiplied. We mould every pad to the same shape and density profile, run after run, so a left pad and right pad match, and so pad 5,000 in an order matches pad 1.

blocks.heading: Shoulder Pad FAQs
blocks.intro: Don't see your question here? Ask us directly and we'll respond within one business day.

items.q: Do you supply pads for both set-in and raglan sleeve styles?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture pad profiles for standard set-in sleeve construction as well as curved profiles built for raglan-style garments. Tell us which construction your pattern uses and we'll confirm the right profile.

items.q: Can pad thickness be customised per style?
items.a: Yes, thickness can be matched to your garment style, from a light lift for softer jackets to a heavier build for coats and structured uniforms. Share your target silhouette and we'll recommend a grade.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity for shoulder pads?
items.a: Minimum quantity depends on the thickness grade and style you need. Contact us with your requirement and we'll confirm feasible order sizes and pricing directly.

items.q: Do the pads hold shape after dry cleaning?
items.a: Our pads are moulded for stable shape retention through normal handling and pressing. For garments going through repeated dry cleaning cycles, let us know so we can confirm the most suitable grade for that use.

blocks.text: Tell us the thickness, style and quantity you need — our team will respond with pricing and lead time within one business day.
